concerns.text: The plan relies exclusively on the ADReSS Challenge *sentence‑embedding* dataset, which contains only pre‑computed embeddings and no raw transcripts. Functional Requirement FR‑001 explicitly requires ingestion of raw text transcripts (and associated labels) to enable lexical and syntactic feature extraction. Using a dataset that lacks the necessary raw text makes the dataset inappropriate for the stated requirement and undermines the ability to compute the required lexical/syntactic markers.

The success criterion SC‑002 demands ≥ 1000 usable records, yet the ADReSS embedding dataset provides only a few hundred participants (≈ 300 after exclusions). The plan attempts to amend the criterion to “≥ 300 records” without a formal spec amendment, which conflicts with the original specification and renders the success criterion unattainable with the cited dataset.
